notes: Run against a form.md workspace with a page 'Billing rewrite' (headings Goals, Invoice numbering, Open questions), a database 'Tasks' and two knowledge items: decision 'Invoices are numbered per workspace starting at 1000' sourced to the Invoice numbering block, and fact 'Billing runs nightly at 02:00 UTC' with no source, last confirmed 200 days ago.

evals.name: pack-before-editing
evals.prompt: Update the Billing rewrite page so the invoice numbering section says numbers restart every January. Check what we already decided first.
expected_behavior: The first form.md call is context_pack with task_type edit and the Billing rewrite page as focus, before any get_page call
The answer cites the recorded decision about numbering starting at 1000 and asks or notes how the yearly restart relates to it before editing
After the edit, knowledge_confirm is called on the numbering decision with verdict supersede and the new text, rather than recording a second, conflicting item

evals.name: resume-from-handoff-with-delta
evals.prompt: Pick up the billing work Codex left yesterday; its note says pack id pk_example. Carry on with the next step.
expected_behavior: context_pack is called with format delta and since set to the given pack id
The agent states the next step from the note and any change the delta shows that the note does not mention, before acting
Decisions the agent relies on are confirmed with knowledge_confirm; nothing is re-recorded that already has an id

evals.name: hygiene-on-stale-fact
evals.prompt: Tidy up what form.md remembers about billing.
expected_behavior: knowledge_review is called for the workspace
The 200-day-old unsourced nightly-run fact is not confirmed from memory: the agent reads a source first or retires or contradicts it, and says which
No verdict is applied to an item without a source read in the same session

evals.name: no-overreach-on-plain-edit
evals.prompt: Rename the page Q3 plan to Q4 plan.
expected_behavior: The rename is done with update_page without first building a context pack or recording knowledge
No knowledge item is created for a rename

evals.name: route-photo-work-to-formlit
evals.prompt: Cull yesterday's wedding shoot down to the best 200 and put the shot list for the album in the Wedding page.
expected_behavior: family_route (or the pack's Form family section) is used before any photo work, and formlit is chosen for the culling
The culling is done through formlit's own MCP server after its consent prompt, or the person is told formlit must be open; no photo data is copied into form.md
The shot list is written to the Wedding page in form.md and names the formlit collection rather than holding the pictures
